n: 7.0 Cu. Ft. Top Load Electric Moisture Sensing Dryer
desc: This top load dryer uses sensor drying technology to help prevent overdrying by stopping the load at just the right time. Easily keep loads on your schedule with the Wrinkle Shield™ Option which helps keep wrinkles from setting with continued tumbling after the cycle ends or use Timed Dry for extra drying time when you need it.
hl: Two sensors closely monitor inside moisture and air temperatures to deliver the right results for each load.
After the cycle ends, help keep wrinkles from setting into clean, dry fabrics with the Wrinkle Shield™ Option.
Take control of your time and the dryness level of your load.
Know when your cycle is finished with an end of cycle buzzer.
Fluff and refresh loads or air out delicates with a cycle that tumbles your items with no heat.
With a 7.0 Cu. Ft. Capacity dryer drum, there’s plenty of room to easily handle the large loads you washed in the matching top load washer.
spec: Air Dry, Bulky Items, Delicates, Heavy Duty, Less Dry, More Dry, Normal, Quick Dry, Timed Dry, Towels, Wrinkle Control
